```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

# Sample data showing the structure of ACS census data with geometry
income_tx <- tibble(
  GEOID = c("48001", "48003", "48005"),
  NAME = c("Anderson County, Texas", "Andrews County, Texas", "Angelina County, Texas"),
  variable = "B19013_001",
  estimate = c(45230, 67890, 52150),
  moe = c(1250, 2100, 1800)
)

# Choropleth map of median household income
# Create mock geometry for demonstration
income_tx_sf <- income_tx %>%
  mutate(
    lon = c(-95.5, -102.5, -94.5),
    lat = c(31.5, 32.5, 31.0)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Create a choropleth-style visualization
ggplot(income_tx_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), size = 3, shape = 21, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Median Household\nIncome ($)",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1/1000, suffix = "K"),
    option = "viridis"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income Across Texas Counties",
    subtitle = "2020 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates",
    caption = "Data Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true

edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent = 100 * sum(estimate[variable != "B15003_001"]) / unique(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(NAME, percent), y = percent, fill = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher by state-level geography (2020)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of adults 25 and over",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false

age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

age_ca |>
  select(NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(label = if_else(min_rank(desc(population)) <= 8, NAME, "")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.75, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, check_overlap = TRUE, size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.25))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Smaller California counties tend to be older (2020)",
    x = "Population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
